prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Produce ONE FINISHED, COMPLETE, VERY TALL iPhone home-screen design image for the Chinese children's habit app 多多打卡. This must be a SINGLE continuous vertical scrolling page, NOT a presentation board or multi-phone collage. Target a very tall approximately 1:5.5 to 1:6 aspect ratio at highest practical resolution, ideally 1024 x 6144 pixels. It is an extended screenshot for app implementation: ONE native navigation/status bar at top, all content in order, ONE native tab bar at absolute bottom. Full-bleed app pixels, zero outer margin, no device bezel, no mockup frame, no perspective, no surrounding scene, no exterior labels or extra elements. Keep the app's proportional width that of a real 390pt iPhone, allowing unlimited vertical scrolling space. DO NOT shrink or truncate any section to fit a normal single screen. Show every one of 17 tasks exactly once.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1, the user's three-phone reference, is PRIMARY for the journey card, individual task card anatomy and CONTENT, icons, colors, type and visual states. Use its TWO-COLUMN cards from first and middle phone. Do NOT use its third phone's single-column structure. Adapt the courage task content from third phone into the same two-column card anatomy.
Image 2, previous revision with five phones, is SECONDARY ONLY for the four group headers and 3D decorative station frames. Preserve the orange/cyan/purple/pink little base decorations from it. Do not copy its exterior cloud scene, multiple phones, all-uncompleted data, or simplified journey.

ONLY THE APP: clean extremely pale neutral gray/lavender native grouped page background. REMOVE the surrounding cloud and planet wallpaper; no background decorations outside the hero and the four section header stations. Individual tasks remain white/pale-mint readable cards. Keep the original panda/rocket hero. Native iOS navigation/title/status and native iOS tab bar; no custom game navigation.

ORDER FROM TOP TO BOTTOM:
A. Native iOS status bar 9:41 and navigation title 多多打卡; small blue info.circle left, blue parent shield right.
B. Panda space hero exactly inspired by Image 1: title 今天也要 / 闪闪发光！ on LEFT, panda astronaut and white-orange rocket on RIGHT. Purple space sky confined INSIDE this hero. A native white progress inset with yellow lightning and warm yellow progress, text 6 / 13, 再得7分，飞船就能出发啦！. Under hero the four native counters: 7 今日自评 | 6 有效打卡 | 0 奖励分 | 家长确认 with parent icon and chevron. No other score figures.
C. Journey card MUST match Image 1's original FIRST PHONE: clean white rounded card, small earth at upper left, bold 我的星际旅程, helper 每50分解锁星球; 本月 6 / 50 and right chevron at upper right. Along the lower half, an ascending curved blue dashed path from a little white-red rocket at far left through four clay solar-system planets: 水星, 金星, 地球, 火星. Mercury shows 6 / 50, other three show 未解锁 and small lock overlays. Keep spacing and composition like the original. Do not replace with invented planets, straight horizontal line or simple lock strip.
D. Energy group:
   orange #FF8D28 header 能量补给站 and count 2 / 5. Small low-profile orange food dome with fork/spoon icon on left; tiny rover at right; rounded layered orange frame and pale ivory interior from Image 2.
   EXACT grid 2 columns x 3 rows, last card left half-width, EMPTY RIGHT CELL:
   row 1 起床 +1 | 吃早饭 +1
   row 2 吃午饭 +1 | 吃晚饭 +1
   row 3 睡觉 +1 | blank.
   起床: large sun + blue bed; timer icon 07:12; green check and 已完成. Pale mint fill and large very translucent approval check stamp at upper-right.
   吃早饭: breakfast noodles/bowl and milk matching Image 1; timer icon 25:11 / 30; green check 已完成, mint fill and translucent approval stamp.
   吃午饭: rice bowl vegetables illustration; timer icon 30分钟, orange 开始 button.
   吃晚饭: dinner plate vegetables/chicken illustration; timer icon 30分钟, orange 开始 button.
   睡觉: moon and sleepy panda illustration; clock icon 晚上9:30, orange 打卡 button.
E. Knowledge group:
   lavender #B0A0FF header 知识探索站 count 1 / 3. Telescope/books left and observatory dome right, dimensional lavender border/pale lilac interior.
   2 columns x 2 rows: 认真听讲 +2 | 写作业 +2 / 阅读 +2 | blank.
   认真听讲: headphones on books matching Image 1; green check 已完成, mint fill and translucent approval stamp.
   写作业: orange pencil and purple spiral notebook, native timer icon and ONLY 12:36, prominent purple 结束 button. This is RUNNING, not completed: no green stamp and no extra 计时中 badge.
   阅读: stacked purple-blue books, timer icon 至少15分钟, purple 开始 button.
F. Life group:
   cyan #00D2E0 header 生活空间站 count 3 / 5. Small cyan star-door habitat domes/mint plants at header corners, dimensional cyan border/pale aqua interior.
   2 columns x 3 rows: 收拾玩具 +1 | 打扫卫生 +1 / 洗漱 +1 | 干净卫生 +1 / 自己穿衣 +1 | blank.
   收拾玩具: teddy and colorful blocks in basket; green check 已完成, mint fill, translucent approval stamp.
   打扫卫生: yellow broom and cyan sparkles, cyan 打卡 button.
   洗漱: blue toothbrush cup and yellow duck, clock icon 晚上9:00, cyan 打卡 button.
   干净卫生: neatly folded mint/lavender towels and pink soap; soft warm yellow pending state, subtle clock indicator, disabled 待确认. NO approval stamp. This accounts for self 7 versus effective 6.
   自己穿衣: folded blue shirt and shorts, green check 已完成, mint fill, translucent approval stamp.
G. Courage group:
   rose #FF375F header 勇气成长站 count 0 / 4. Rose-pink dome with star doorway left and little flag outpost right; dimensional rose border/pale blush interior.
   2 columns x 2 rows: 乖巧听话 +2 | 不发脾气 +2 / 做事不拖拉 +2 | 诚实守信 +1.
   Reuse EXACT task card CONTENT from Image 1's right phone but arrange two-column:
   乖巧听话: panda hugging pink heart; 认真回应，做好宝宝; pink 打卡.
   不发脾气: calm seated panda with mint leaves; 做情绪的小主人; pink 打卡.
   做事不拖拉: lavender lightning, subdued/grayed card illustration; 三餐、作业后解锁; lock icon and disabled 尚未解锁.
   诚实守信: pink shield with white check; 说真话，不撒谎; pink 打卡.
H. A tiny restrained footer 每天一点点，成长看得见。 then the native iOS three-item tab bar 今日打卡 / 打卡统计 / 积分消耗, first selected blue/purple, black home indicator.

TASK CARD ANATOMY MUST FOLLOW IMAGE 1: title and small gold star +points together on TOP ROW, large standalone clay illustration centered below, then concise timer/subtitle, then native rounded action button or green check 已完成 row. Uncompleted cards white; completed cards subtly mint; approval stamp upper-right translucent and not obscuring title. Color-native buttons by group. No duplicate artwork per card, no added levels or decorative coins. Native Chinese typography, real iPhone legibility and comfortable touch targets. All 17 cards SAME HALF-WIDTH, no full-width odd rows, no single-column exceptions. No exaggerated empty spacer between sections. Keep content crisp enough for a developer to use as visual reference.

Preserve continuity: the four decorated group containers are stacked inside the SAME narrow app page, not four detached phones. Complete all 17 cards, all four full section frames, all header/journey content and bottom tab in a single tall image. Prioritize correct task names and exact states, particularly green 已完成, purple 结束 with 12:36, yellow 待确认 and gray lock 尚未解锁. No exterior scene or background, no extra headings describing the design.
